items.title: Web Performance Is a Journey [PerfNow 2026]
items.summary: Our industry has spent a couple of decades being confident about things that turned out to be wrong – and that's okay. The gap between what we expected and what the data actually shows is one of the subjects of this talk. Underneath every metric, protocol, and best practice we've ever chased is the same challenge: performance is a proxy for how people experience software, and people are not simple enough to sum up in a few metrics.That's the starting point, not the destination. Harder questions are ahead of us. Questions like what does "fast" even mean when an interface starts answering before it's finished thinking, how much uncertainty will people tolerate from software that's probabilistic instead of deterministic, and why nothing in our observability tooling can tell us when a user is confused instead of content. We don't know what we don't know. This talk is an argument for why that's exciting.
